description: Read SEC Form 4 transactions and filing receipts. Uses the filters and plan limits of /api/v1/insiders. When more results exist on free access, page.next_cursor_withheld is plan_limit and page.next_cursor is null. See https://www.veridionmarkets.com/api/v1/openapi.json for full response fields.
name: list_insiders

has_more.description: More matching lines exist than this response returns; receipt holds can leave a short page. Reported truthfully on every tier; only a Developer key receives a cursor. On an accession lookup it means the filing has more lines than limit.

next_cursor.description: Signed, query-bound position and serving revision for the next Developer page, or null. Always null on free access and on accession lookups. Evidence changes require a new walk.

next_cursor_withheld.description: plan_limit when more results exist on free access. Null otherwise.
